questions.title: Requirement 3.1
questions.question: If toilet rooms are available to the public, is at least one toilet room accessible? (Either one for each sex, or one unisex.)
solutionsIfNo: Combine toilet rooms to create one unisex accessible toilet room

questions.title: Requirement 3.2
questions.question: Are there signs at inaccessible toilet rooms that give directions to accessible toilet rooms?

questions.title: Requirement 3.3
questions.question: If not all toilet rooms are accessible, is there a sign at the accessible toilet room with the International Symbol of Accessibility?

questions.title: Requirement 3.4
questions.question: Is there an accessible route to the accessible toilet room?

questions.title: Requirement 3.5.1
questions.question: Do text characters contrast with their backgrounds?

questions.title: Requirement 3.5.2
questions.question: Are text characters raised?

questions.title: Requirement 3.5.3
questions.question: Is there Braille?

questions.title: Requirement 3.5.4
questions.question: Is the sign mounted on the wall on the latch side of the door?

questions.title: Requirement 3.5.5
questions.question: With clear floor space beyond the arc of the door swing between the closed position and 45-degree open position, at least 18 x 18 inches centered on the tactile characters?

questions.title: Requirement 3.5.6
questions.question: So the baseline of the lowest character is at least 48 inches above the floor and the baseline of the highest character is no more than 60 inches above the floor?

questions.title: Requirement 3.6
questions.question: Is the door opening width at least 32 inches clear, between the face of the door and the stop, when the door is open 90 degrees?

questions.title: Requirement 3.7.1
questions.question: If there is a front approach to the pull side of the door is there at least 18 inches of maneuvering clearance beyond the latch side plus 60 inches clear depth?

questions.title: Requirement 3.7.2
questions.question: On both sides of the door, is the floor surface of the maneuvering clearance level (no steeper than 1:48)?

questions.title: Requirement 3.8.1
questions.question: If the threshold is vertical is it no more than ¼ inch high?

questions.title: Requirement 3.8.2
questions.question: No more than ½ inch high with the top ¼ inch beveled no steeper than 1:2, if the threshold was installed on or after the 1991 ADA Standards went into effect (1/26/93)?

questions.title: Requirement 3.8.3
questions.question: No more than ¾ inch high with the top ½ inch beveled no steeper than 1:2, if the threshold was installed before the 1991 ADA Standards went into effect (1/26/93)?

questions.title: Requirement 3.9.1
questions.question: Is the door equipped with hardware that is operable with one hand and does not require tight grasping, pinching or twisting of the wrist?
solutionsIfNo: Replace inaccessible knob with lever, loop or push hardware

questions.title: Requirement 3.9.2
questions.question: Door handle?
solutionsIfNo: Replace inaccessible knob with lever, loop or push hardware

questions.title: Requirement 3.9.3
questions.question: Lock (if provided)?
solutionsIfNo: Replace inaccessible knob with lever, loop or push hardware

questions.title: Requirement 3.10
questions.question: Are the operable parts of the door hardware mounted no less than 34 inches and no greater than 48 inches above the floor?

questions.title: Requirement 3.11
questions.question: Can the door be opened easily (5 pounds maximum force)?
solutionsIfNo: Install power-assisted or automatic door openers

questions.title: Requirement 3.12
questions.question: If the door has a closer, does it take at least 5 seconds to close from an open position of 90 degrees to a position of 12 degrees from the latch?

questions.title: Requirement 3.13
questions.question: If there are two doors in a series, e.g. vestibule, is the distance between the doors at least 48 inches plus the width of the doors when swinging into the space?

questions.title: Requirement 3.14
questions.question: If there is a privacy wall and the door swings out, is there at least 24 inches of maneuvering clearance beyond the door latch side and 42 inches to the privacy wall?

questions.title: Requirement 3.15
questions.question: If there is a privacy wall and the door swings in, is there at least 24 inches of maneuvering clearance beyond the door latch side and at least 48 inches to the privacy wall if there is no door closer or at least 54 inches if there is a door closer?

questions.title: Requirement 3.16
questions.question: Is there a clear path to at least one of each type of fixture, e.g. lavatory, hand dryer, etc., that is at least 36 inches wide?

questions.title: Requirement 3.17
questions.question: Is there clear floor space available for a person in a wheelchair to turn around, i.e. a circle at least 60 inches in diameter or a T-shaped space within a 60-inch square?
solutionsIfNo: Move or remove partitions, fixtures or objects such as trash cans

questions.title: Requirement 3.18
questions.question: In a single user toilet room if the door swings in and over a clear floor space at an accessible fixture, is there a clear floor space at least 30 x 48 inches beyond the swing of the door?

questions.title: Requirement 3.19.1
questions.question: If the mirror is over a lavatory or countertop, is the bottom edge of the reflecting surface no higher than 40 inches above the floor?

questions.title: Requirement 3.19.2
questions.question: If the mirror is not over the lavatory or countertop, is the bottom edge of the reflecting surface no higher than 35 inches above the floor?

questions.title: Requirement 3.20
questions.question: If there is a coat hook, is it no less than 15 inches and no greater than 48 inches above the floor?
solutionsIfNo: Replace with or provide additional accessible hook

questions.title: Requirement 3.21
questions.question: Does at least one lavatory have a clear floor space for a forward approach at least 30 inches wide and 48 inches long?

questions.title: Requirement 3.22
questions.question: Do no less than 17 inches and no greater than 25 inches of the clear floor space extend under the lavatory so that a person using a wheelchair can get close enough to reach the faucet?

questions.title: Requirement 3.23
questions.question: Is the front of the lavatory or counter surface, whichever is higher, no more than 34 inches above the floor?

questions.title: Requirement 3.24
questions.question: Is there at least 27 inches clearance from the floor to the bottom of the lavatory that extends at least 8 inches under the lavatory for knee clearance?

questions.title: Requirement 3.25
questions.question: Is there toe clearance at least 9 inches high?

questions.title: Requirement 3.26
questions.question: Are pipes below the lavatory insulated or otherwise configured to protect against contact?

questions.title: Requirement 3.27.1
questions.question: Can the faucet be operated without tight grasping, pinching, or twisting of the wrist?

questions.title: Requirement 3.27.2
questions.question: Is the force required to activate the faucet no greater than 5 pounds?

questions.title: Requirement 3.28.1
questions.question: Are the operable parts of the soap dispenser, above lavatories or counters no less than 20 inches and no greater than 25 inches deep, no higher than 44 inches above the floor?
solutionsIfNo: Replace with or provide additional accessible dispensers

questions.title: Requirement 3.28.2
questions.question: Are the operable parts of the soap dispenser, above lavatories less than 20 inches deep, no higher than 48 inches above the floor?
solutionsIfNo: Replace with or provide additional accessible dispensers

questions.title: Requirement 3.28.3
questions.question: Are the operable parts of the soap dispenser, not over an obstruction, no higher than 48 inches above the floor?
solutionsIfNo: Replace with or provide additional accessible dispensers

questions.title: Requirement 3.29.1
questions.question: Are the operable parts of the hand dryer or towel dispenser, above lavatories or counters no less than 20 inches and no greater than 25 inches deep, no higher than 44 inches above the floor?
solutionsIfNo: Replace with or provide additional accessible dispensers

questions.title: Requirement 3.29.2
questions.question: Are the operable parts of the hand dryer or towel dispenser, above lavatories less than 20 inches deep, no higher than 48 inches above the floor?
solutionsIfNo: Replace with or provide additional accessible dispensers

questions.title: Requirement 3.29.3
questions.question: Are the operable parts of the hand dryer or towel dispenser, not over an obstruction, no higher than 48 inches above the floor?
solutionsIfNo: Replace with or provide additional accessible dispensers

questions.title: Requirement 3.29.4
questions.question: Can the operable parts of the hand dryer or towel dispenser be operated without tight grasping, pinching or twisting of the wrist?
solutionsIfNo: Replace with or provide additional accessible dispensers

questions.title: Requirement 3.29.5
questions.question: Is the force required to activate the hand dryer or towel dispenser no greater than 5 pounds?
solutionsIfNo: Replace with or provide additional accessible dispensers

questions.title: Requirement 3.30
questions.question: Is the centerline of the water closet no less than 16 inches and no greater than 18 inches from the side wall or partition?

questions.title: Requirement 3.31
questions.question: Is clearance provided around the water closet measuring at least 60 inches from the side wall and at least 56 inches from the rear wall?

questions.title: Requirement 3.32
questions.question: Is the height of the water closet no less than 17 inches and no greater than 19 inches above the floor measured to the top of the seat?

questions.title: Requirement 3.33.1
questions.question: Is there a grab bar at least 42 inches long on the side wall?

questions.title: Requirement 3.33.2
questions.question: Is it located no more than 12 inches from the rear wall?

questions.title: Requirement 3.33.3
questions.question: Does it extend at least 54 inches from the rear wall?

questions.title: Requirement 3.33.4
questions.question: Is it mounted no less than 33 inches and no greater than 36 inches above the floor to the top of the gripping surface?

questions.title: Requirement 3.33.5
questions.question: Is there at least 12 inches clearance between the grab bar and projecting objects above?

questions.title: Requirement 3.33.6
questions.question: Is there at least 1½ inches clearance between the grab bar and projecting objects below?

questions.title: Requirement 3.33.7
questions.question: Is the space between the wall and the grab bar 1½ inches?

questions.title: Requirement 3.34.1
questions.question: Is there a grab bar at least 36 inches long on the rear wall?

questions.title: Requirement 3.34.2
questions.question: Does it extend at least 12 inches from the centerline of the water closet on one side (side wall)?

questions.title: Requirement 3.34.3
questions.question: Does it extend at least 24 inches on the other (open) side?

questions.title: Requirement 3.34.4
questions.question: Is it mounted no less than 33 inches and no greater than 36 inches above the floor to the top of the gripping surface?

questions.title: Requirement 3.34.5
questions.question: Are there at least 12 inches clearance between the grab bar and protruding objects above?

questions.title: Requirement 3.34.6
questions.question: Are there at least 1½ inches clearance between the grab bar and projecting objects below?

questions.title: Requirement 3.34.7
questions.question: Is the space between the wall and the grab bar 1½ inches?

questions.title: Requirement 3.35
questions.question: If the flush control is hand operated, is the operable part located no higher than 48 inches above the floor?
solutionsIfNo: Install sensor with override button no higher than 48 inches

questions.title: Requirement 3.36.1
questions.question: If the flush control is hand operated, can it be operated with one hand and without tight grasping, pinching, or twisting of the wrist?

questions.title: Requirement 3.36.2
questions.question: Is the force required to activate the flush control no greater than 5 pounds?

questions.title: Requirement 3.37
questions.question: Is the flush control on the open side of the water closet?

questions.title: Requirement 3.38
questions.question: Is the toilet paper dispenser located no less than 7 inches and no greater than 9 inches from the front of the water closet to the centerline of the dispenser?

questions.title: Requirement 3.39.1
questions.question: Is the outlet of the dispenser located no less than 15 inches and no greater than 48 inches above the floor?

questions.title: Requirement 3.39.2
questions.question: Is the outlet of the dispenser not located behind grab bars?

questions.title: Requirement 3.40
questions.question: Does the dispenser allow continuous paper flow?

questions.title: Requirement 3.41
questions.question: Is the door opening width at least 32 inches clear, between the face of the door and the stop, when the door is open 90 degrees?

questions.title: Requirement 3.42
questions.question: If there is a front approach to the pull side of the door, is there at least 18 inches of maneuvering clearance beyond the latch side plus 60 inches clear depth?

questions.title: Requirement 3.43
questions.question: Is the door self-closing?

questions.title: Requirement 3.44
questions.question: Are there door pulls on both sides of the door that are operable with one hand and do not require tight grasping pinching or twisting of the wrist?

questions.title: Requirement 3.45
questions.question: Is the lock operable with one hand and without tight grasping, pinching or twisting of the wrist?

questions.title: Requirement 3.46
questions.question: Are the operable parts of the door hardware mounted no less than 34 inches and no greater than 48 inches above the floor?

questions.title: Requirement 3.47
questions.question: Is the compartment at least 60 inches wide?

questions.title: Requirement 3.48
questions.question: If the water closet is wall hung, is the compartment at least 56 inches deep?

questions.title: Requirement 3.49
questions.question: If the water closet is floor mounted, is the compartment at least 59 inches deep?

questions.title: Requirement 3.50
questions.question: If the door swings in, is the minimum required compartment area provided beyond the swing of the door (60 inches x 56 inches if water closet is wall hung or 59 inches if water closet is floor mounted)?
